mapper.sql: achievement_id as "achievementId", faculty_user_id as "facultyUserId", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", academic_year as "academicYear", semester, student_no as "studentNo", student_name as "studentName", guidance_type as "guidanceType", guidance_date as "guidanceDate", guidance_content as "guidanceContent", achievement_status as "achievementStatus", management_item_setting_id as "managementItemSettingId", dynamic_fields::text as "dynamicFieldsJson", attachment_refs::text as "attachmentRefsJson", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt"

sql.where: faculty_user_id = #{facultyUserId} and deleted_yn = 'N' and evaluation_year = #{criteria.evaluationYear} and academic_year = #{criteria.academicYear} and semester = #{criteria.semester} and guidance_type = #{criteria.guidanceType} and achievement_status = #{criteria.achievementStatus} and (student_no ilike concat('%', #{criteria.studentKeyword}, '%') or student_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.studentKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: select from student_guidance_achievements order by guidance_date desc, achievement_id desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.safePage} * #{criteria.safeSize}
select from student_guidance_achievements where achievement_id=#{achievementId} and faculty_user_id=#{facultyUserId} and deleted_yn='N'

select from student_guidance_achievements where faculty_user_id=#{facultyUserId} and student_no=#{studentNo} and guidance_type=#{guidanceType} and guidance_date=cast(#{guidanceDate} as date) and deleted_yn='N'
mapper.insert: insert into student_guidance_achievements (faculty_user_id,evaluation_year,academic_year,semester,student_no,student_name,guidance_type,guidance_date,guidance_content,achievement_status,management_item_setting_id,dynamic_fields,attachment_refs,created_by,updated_by) values (#{facultyUserId},#{request.evaluationYear},#{request.academicYear},#{request.semester},#{request.studentNo},#{request.studentName},#{request.guidanceType},#{request.guidanceDate},#{request.guidanceContent},'DRAFTING',#{request.managementItemSettingId},cast(#{dynamicFieldsJson} as jsonb),cast(#{attachmentRefsJson} as jsonb),#{facultyUserId},#{facultyUserId})
mapper.update: update student_guidance_achievements set evaluation_year=#{request.evaluationYear},academic_year=#{request.academicYear},semester=#{request.semester},student_no=#{request.studentNo},student_name=#{request.studentName},guidance_type=#{request.guidanceType},guidance_date=#{request.guidanceDate},guidance_content=#{request.guidanceContent},management_item_setting_id=#{request.managementItemSettingId},dynamic_fields=cast(#{dynamicFieldsJson} as jsonb),attachment_refs=cast(#{attachmentRefsJson} as jsonb),updated_at=current_timestamp,updated_by=#{facultyUserId} where achievement_id=#{request.achievementId} and faculty_user_id=#{facultyUserId} and deleted_yn='N' and achievement_status <> 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED'
mapper.insert: insert into excel_upload_histories (upload_id,total_count,success_count,error_count,excluded_count,saved_count,processing_time_millis,processor_user_id) values (#{uploadId},#{totalCount},#{successCount},#{errorCount},0,#{savedCount},0,#{facultyUserId}) on conflict (upload_id) do update set total_count=excluded.total_count,success_count=excluded.success_count,error_count=excluded.error_count,saved_count=excluded.saved_count,processor_user_id=excluded.processor_user_id,processed_at=current_timestamp
mapper.select: select row_number as "rowNumber",column_name as "columnName",error_code as "errorCode",error_reason as "errorReason" from excel_upload_errors where upload_id=#{uploadId} and status='ACTIVE' order by row_number,column_name
